Abstract:

Mine optimisation and planning are critical components of efficient and sustainable mining operations, directly influencing resource recovery, operational productivity, and economic performance. However, the practical implementation of mine optimisation often faces challenges arising from geological uncertainties, equipment constraints, operational limitations, and fluctuating market conditions. This talk presents a pragmatic approach to mine optimisation and planning through a case study of a mining operation, focusing on the integration of geological, technical, operational, and economic parameters into a practical mine planning framework.
